# Parser fixtures

All fixtures here are independently authored synthetic events. Names, IDs and timestamps are invented. They exercise supported event layouts; they do not certify a specific live client build.

`retail.log` covers repeated raid pulls, wipe/kill, Unicode character metadata, death, and a 45-minute Mythic+ run with nested boss events. `classic.log` covers raid and zone-based arena/battleground boundaries. Zone-based clips retain unknown outcomes.

Real client-version fixtures and recordings are still required for the release compatibility matrix. Do not substitute these synthetic samples for that evidence.
